description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Raththinakumar was elected as the member of the ward No. 08. Kokadicholi of the Manmunai South West Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Manmunai South West Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member. It specifically deals with the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member. This falls squarely under election-related matters, making it Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) rather than a government personnel or structural classification.
